items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You know, there's a place right down the street, that guy Earl Schmidt, he's a lawyer. [INTERVIEWEE] Who?

ctx.x: Well, you see how we used to do. When we had our little band up like that, we had a little reader there, Peter's little boy used to play trumpet too, you know. Well, I used to play with him sometimes. Well, we'd go out and play a dance like that, somebody come ask for a number and we don't have it. We'd come back, Peter would write that number out for us. You see? He'd write that number out and we'd go back again, boy, play it.
You know, there's a place right down the street, that guy Earl Schmidt, he's a lawyer.
